selectedRule.when: When implementation is complete, implementation-scoped validation and the lightweight implementation self-review are complete, the carried classification is task_size=Small or Medium and architectural_risk=Low, and the cumulative package is ready for direct API/E2E validation without Code Reviewer.

reason: Initial implementation complete; local checks and self-review complete; cumulative package ready. Large/High, Local Fix and upstream-gap conditions do not apply.
notificationPolicy: One matching most-specific rule; notify only exact returned /api_e2e_engineer.
